rivalries.description: The fiercest rivalry in Egyptian football. The Cairo Derby between the two biggest clubs in the country transcends sport — it divides families, neighborhoods, and even workplaces. Matches are always sold out and surrounded by intense media coverage.
rivalries.description_ar: أشرس تنافس في كرة القدم المصرية. ديربي القاهرة بين أكبر ناديين في البلاد يتجاوز الرياضة — يقسم العائلات والأحياء وحتى أماكن العمل.

rivalries.description: The Canal Derby between two major clubs represents a clash of playing styles and regional pride. Both clubs have passionate fan bases and a long history of dramatic encounters.
rivalries.description_ar: ديربي القناة بين ناديين كبيرين يمثل صراع أساليب اللعب والفخر الإقليمي.

rivalries.description: The Mediterranean Derby pits two coastal powerhouses against each other. With deep-rooted fan cultures and ultras groups, these matches are always electric affairs.
rivalries.description_ar: ديربي المتوسط يضع قوتين ساحليتين في مواجهة بعضهما البعض.

rivalries.description: A rivalry born from years of title races. When these two meet, the league title is often on the line.
rivalries.description_ar: منافسة ولدت من سنوات من سباقات اللقب.

rivalries.description: The Upper Egypt Derby brings together clubs from the south, representing regional pride and a physical, no-nonsense style of play.
rivalries.description_ar: ديربي الصعيد يجمع أندية الجنوب، يمثل الفخر الإقليمي وأسلوب لعب بدني.
